claims.statement: Funnel and Retention take a long event log (entity, event, timestamp); one synthetic product event log feeds both.
A stage counts only after the previous stage was reached; first occurrence wins; optional conversion window, default none.
Retained in period N means any qualifying event in elapsed period N; cohort size is the denominator.
Preparation is chart-owned pure plan code shown in the trace; no new analysis-step kinds. Funnel and Timeline need dedicated rendering.
Clicking a funnel stage or retention cell selects every event of the qualifying entities.
Schedules mean an interactive linked timeline over a synthetic resource-bookings set; brushing a window keeps overlapping intervals. Concurrency strip and overlap highlight are later.
claims.notes: Click-select treated as standard chart behavior; provisional.

claims.statement: Funnel, then Retention, then Timeline; one stacked PR each with docs page and demo example.

success_moves: Prove counting rules in pure plan modules against hand fixtures before rendering.
Store selections as stage index, cohort cell, or window on the chart and rebuild entity sets in getFilterFunction, avoiding filter-model changes.
Put the riskiest per-entity selection in M1 so M2 reuses it.
Plant ordering traps in the synthetic event log so the demo itself exercises the rules.
Reuse Sankey plan/trace layout, heatScale/HeatLegend, and BaseChart horizontal brush.
Each chart is one registry entry, so rollback is removing it.
